items.title: Ben Sidran interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 15, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know, I think of Kenny Davern, the marvelous clarinet player.

ctx.x: Well because at heart I’m just a huge jazz fan. It’s all I ever wanted to do was be involved in the music and these are all different aspects of how I got involved in the music. So to me it’s all kind of the same thing. I mean playing piano is something I’ve done since I was six years old and it doesn’t feel any different than doing an interview on the radio or whatever. All those things that we tend to think of as separate really aren’t at all, they’re just ways to go through the jazz life, which isn’t an easy…

I like that analogy of legs on a stool. I know, I think of Kenny Davern, the marvelous clarinet player. And he somehow made a living just being a clarinet player. Not — no studio work, he was in a big band for a very short time and he said no I’m not going to do that. And all the things that you’ve done — have they affected your questions that you asked during your interviews that you’ve done?
